message:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], many thanks for getting back to me so quickly and for your interest in the project!

To answer your question, we’d prefer to receive them as separate files. MP3 format would also be perfectly fine and sufficient.

Thanks again—we’re looking forward to receiving the tracks and listening to them!

Hello dear,

Please accept my sincere apologies for the late response. An emergency came up, and I needed to take a few days off. I appreciate your patience, the multiple takes you sent, and all the effort you put into them.

After going through them, I think **Take Two** is better than the rest, particularly regarding the pauses. However, we’d love to try one more version with even greater energy and liveliness in the delivery.

I’m sharing an AI-generated sample now solely as a reference for the tone and energy we’re trying to achieve. Of course, your vibrant voice will bring it to life much better!

I know there’s a time difference, but please tell me when you’re available to record today so I can ensure I’m online and responsive.

Best regards!

Good morning—at least it is here. I hope everything is okay on your end.

In two hours or so, I’ll be able to start working on your project. I have a few other quick projects ahead of yours first. I’ll notify ya when I begin. Does that sound good?

Good morning! Yes, elhamdolellah, everything is good—thank you so much :)

And yes, that works for me. Good luck with your projects; I’ll be waiting for your notification!
Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001], I’m getting started now. If I have any questions, I’ll keep ya updated.
Thank you, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] here and available for any questions.
Perfect. I’ve just recorded three takes, and they’re still raw and unedited. Give them a listen and tell me which, if any, of those three you like: First, second or third.

Hi, thank you. I liked the first one, but I think the final sentence, “without you having to wait..”, contains too many pauses.

Could we make it flow more smoothly and sound inspiring, with a slight sense of pride, while also avoiding overacting?
Okay: smoother, inspiring, pride, energy and liveliness....Here are five more. The first one combines the first one ya liked with a revision of the last sentence.
To reiterate, these files are also raw.

Thank you, [FREELANCER_NAME_001].

The 2nd & 3rd takes actually go in two different directions, but both are really good!

Could you edit both and send them separately so I can forward them to the top managers for approval?

I’ll make the 1st payment today, but for the remaining amount, could we wait until Sunday to get final approval for the final take?

Hello [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I really appreciate all your effort and how quickly you’ve responded.

One of the last two takes has already been approved, so we can now move forward with the remaining payment of 10$.

Thanks, dear!

Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001]! It’s great to hear from you today.
This news makes me so happy! Thank you for your kind words.
Enjoy the rest of your day.
Many thanks, [FREELANCER_NAME_001], and apologies for the delayed transfer!
